notes.text: Seth Jarvis is out and has not played this season. He is a top-six forward. William Carrier has taken his spot beside Sebastian Aho and Andrei Svechnikov.
Mark Jankowski is out (lower-body injury) and missed their last game. He is one of their more valuable skaters. Nicolas Deslauriers has taken his spot beside Eric Robinson and Jesperi Kotkaniemi.
Taylor Hall is on injured reserve and has missed the last 2 games. Bradly Nadeau has taken his spot beside Logan Stankoven and Jackson Blake.
Jordan Staal is out 1-2 months (calf tear) and has missed the last 4 games. Felix Unger Sörum has taken his spot beside Jordan Martinook and Nikolaj Ehlers.
Bradly Nadeau was added to the roster on Oct 15 and has played beside Logan Stankoven and Jackson Blake.
Felix Unger Sörum was added to the roster on Oct 17 and has played beside Jordan Martinook and Nikolaj Ehlers.
Logan Stankoven has started killing penalties: on the ice for 35% of the team’s shorthanded time in 10 games, up from 1% last season.

faceoff.text: Jordan Staal is sent out to take power-play faceoffs, then changes. He has taken 39% of the team’s power-play draws but stays on for about 20 seconds at a time, against 65 for the regulars, and is most often replaced by Nikolaj Ehlers (17 of 20 changes).

notes.text: The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 10 games cover only 30% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the fifth-lowest in the league (a typical team: 43%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Marco Rossi is out (illness) and missed their last game. He is a top-six forward.
Max Sasson has started killing penalties: on the ice for 33% of the team’s shorthanded time in 10 games, up from 4% last season.

VAN.head: A steep climb for the Canucks
VAN.body: Even though Vancouver has home-ice advantage and Carolina will be without Jankowski, the Hurricanes have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Canucks’ best hope is getting good looks, plus a big night in goal.

CAR.head: The Hurricanes should be in control
CAR.body: Even though Vancouver has home-ice advantage and Carolina will be without Jankowski, the Hurricanes have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Canucks’ best way in is getting good looks.

story.head: Something has to change for the Canucks
paras: The Canucks are winless in seven (0-6-1). The Hurricanes are 7-2-1. The Hurricanes won the first meeting this season, 7-2 in Carolina.

items.text: Andrei Svechnikov has a point in five straight games against Vancouver, with a goal in each of the last four, and 9 points in his last five against them.
The Hurricanes are newly without Mark Jankowski and Taylor Hall, have been without Jordan Staal since Oct 10, and have had to make do without Seth Jarvis all season.
The Canucks are newly without Marco Rossi, and have had to make do without Thatcher Demko all season. Leevi Meriläinen is expected to start.
